## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes locally (typecheck, lint, tests, build)
- [ ] New or changed behaviour is covered by tests (runtime, property-based, or type-level)
- [ ] Curriculum changes pass `npm run research:verify`
- [ ] Documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` updated where relevant
